v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Miserére * mei, Deus, secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam. ‡
text.en: Have mercy on me, * O God, according to thy great mercy. ‡

text.la: Deduc me * in iustítia tua, Dómine.
text.en: Conduct me, * O Lord, in thy justice.

text.la: Dóminus dabit virtútem * et benedícet pópulo suo in pace.
text.en: God will give * power and strength to his people.

text.la: Convérsus est furor tuus, * Dómine, et consolátus es me.
text.en: Thy wrath is turned away * and thou hast comforted me.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia eius.
text.en: Praise * the Lord, for his mercy is confirmed upon us.

text.la: Veníte, mittámus lignum in panem eius, et eradámus eum de terra vivéntium, et nomen eius non memorétur ámplius.
text.en: Come, let us put wood on his bread, and cut him off from the land of the living, and let his name be remembered no more.

v.la: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Deus meus.
v.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God.

r.la: Et ab insurgéntibus in me líbera me.
r.en: And defend me from them that rise up against me.

text.la: In die magno * festivitátis stabat Iesus, et clamábat dicens: Si quis sitit, véniat ad me, et bibat.
text.en: In the last day, that great day of the Feast, * Jesus stood and cried, saying: If any man thirst, let Him come unto Me, and drink.

text.la: Sanctífica, quǽsumus, Dómine, nostra ieiúnia: et cunctárum nobis indulgéntiam propítius largíre culpárum.
text.en: Hallow, O Lord, we beseech thee, this our Fast, and mercifully grant us forgiveness of all our trespasses.
